sources.origin: Serve Robotics Investor Relations landing page

factors.name: operatingScaleVerification
factors.basis: Current issuer IR refreshes operating-scale context but does not establish utilization or unit economics.

risks: Headline deployed-fleet and merchant counts can overstate economic progress if utilization and contribution economics remain weak.
contradictions: Large operating footprint coexists with the packet's Q2 2026 revenue-guidance reduction; physical reach is not equivalent to monetized demand.
unknowns: Current revenue per robot, utilization by market and contribution margin by delivery channel remain undisclosed in this source.
result: Current primary-source operating-scale evidence packaged for Alpha; numeric underwriting remains Alpha-owned.
